zephyr-client-fixed.built_as: the fixed-memory client of overlays/t2g_client_fixed.conf with the idle wait and batching off (main stack 9216 bytes), its node wz_session_mcu::slot_node
zephyr-client-fixed.measured: 2026-10-23, the T2G kit (CYT4BF M7) on its own Ethernet to a zenohd on the bench host; the stack line is the same in 7 of 7 runs, the GET figure is the median of 14 medians (0.320 to 0.471 ms) of 2000 queries for each of the node's two documents. The stack figures were re-read on 2026-10-27 after the not-a-Frame dispatch was split into decode, judge and engine steps (static chain 6,940, peak 6,060 in 2 of 2 runs, GETs inside their row; the tree before the split read 7,152 and 6,336, and the one before log_args 7,296 and 6,480): the decoded handshake message no longer sits in a frame under the engine's answer, and the worst chain is now the connect manager's dial path

zephyr-client-fixed-batching.built_as: the fixed-memory client of overlays/t2g_client_batching.conf with one send window sent as one datagram, the idle wait off (main stack 10240 bytes), its node wz_session_mcu::slot_node
zephyr-client-fixed-batching.measured: 2026-10-23, the T2G kit (CYT4BF M7) on its own Ethernet to a zenohd on the bench host; the stack line is the same in 3 of 3 runs, the GET figure is the median of 6 medians (0.287 to 0.462 ms) of 2000 queries for each of the node's two documents. The two stack figures were re-measured on 2026-10-27 (static chain 7460, peak 6328 in 3 of 3 runs) and moved from 7204 and 6016: the slot node keeps the latest sample of a subscription (chain +136) and holds sessions a peer opened beside the dialled ones (+64), the connect manager is held by the shared planner and by nodes' zids (+88), a few smaller steps, and the log lines are no longer inlined into the main frame (-144); on 2026-10-27 the not-a-Frame dispatch was split into decode, judge and engine steps and the two read 6940 and 6060 in 2 of 2 runs (the worst chain is now the connect manager's dial path); the GET figure was not re-measured

zephyr-client-fixed-get.built_as: the fixed-memory client of overlays/t2g_client_get.conf, which also asks one query at a time (two pending rows), the idle wait and batching off (main stack 12288 bytes); its node is wz_session_mcu::slot_node and its getter wz_session_mcu::slot_getter
zephyr-client-fixed-get.measured: 2026-10-23, the T2G kit (CYT4BF M7) asking a responder on the bench host, a client of a zenohd there, for a document of 165 bytes, 2050 queries with 50 of warm-up; the stack line and the getter's median (300 us, p99 1300 to 1400 us) are the same in 8 of 8 clean runs; the kernel tick is 100 us, so the median has that resolution. The two stack figures were re-measured on 2026-10-27 (static chain 7784, peak 8328 in 3 of 3 runs) and moved from 7672 and 8144; the changes on this path since 2026-10-23 are those named in the batching row, and this image's own share of them was not bisected; the same day the not-a-Frame dispatch was split into decode, judge and engine steps and the two read 7092 and 6648 in 2 of 2 runs (the worst chain is now the connect manager's dial path, and the reading is under it, so the chain is a bound again and the `chain_misses` key of the row is gone); the getter's median was not re-measured

zephyr-client-fixed-tls.built_as: the fixed-memory client of overlays/t2g_client_tls.conf, which dials tls/ over Zephyr's TCP with the secure channel (wz-tls-mbedtls on Zephyr's Mbed TLS 4.1.0, mutual TLS 1.3, its 49,152-byte arena), the idle wait and batching off (main stack 12288 bytes), its node wz_session_mcu::slot_node
zephyr-client-fixed-tls.measured: 2026-10-24, the T2G kit (CYT4BF M7) on its own Ethernet to a zenohd 1.10.1 on the bench host that pins the image's certificate and is verified by it; the stack line is the same in 8 of 8 runs, the GET figure is the median of 8 medians (0.583 to 0.765 ms) of 2000 queries for each of the node's two documents; the client without the channel, run in turn with it, gave medians of 0.395 to 0.472 ms. The two stack figures were re-read on 2026-10-27 (static chain 7432 and peak 6752 in 2 of 2 runs, session established, peer verified) and moved from 7016 and 6864: the peak fell 112 with the split of the not-a-Frame dispatch into decode, judge and engine steps, and the chain, 7432 with and without that split, rose 416 with the connect manager's dial path since 2026-10-24, which was not bisected; the GET figure was not re-measured
